title: Anthropic · 更新日志来源更新
summary: We announced the deprecation of the Claude Sonnet 4.5 model (claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929), with retirement on the Claude API scheduled for November 30, 2026. We recommend migrating to Claude Sonnet 5.5. Read more in Model deprecations.
